text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Today's menu: Red Light, Green Light! The distance
to the school gate is far greater than last time—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Um, question...! May I ask something?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
First unicycles, now Red Light, Green Light... Is it really
okay if our training feels just like playing games?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's super fun and all! But shouldn't we
be doing standard strength workouts?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oho, cravin' more hardcore thrills, are ya? Say no
more, kiddo! I'll crank up the dial just for you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Indeed! For the sake of our beloved underclassmen,
this class president shall pull out all the stops!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Alrighty! Sit tight a sec!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —And so! We have summoned the other teams!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yep, rounded up the whole gang!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Let us begin! A three-team joint practice session:
Survival Tag!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Those tagged become the 'oni', and the previous oni
become runners! Whoever is not 'it' when time runs out wins!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: So even joint practice is basically just games~?!
And thus, our joint game of tag commenced—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew... Think I finally shook them off... Time for a breather...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Bright-san was chasing me the entire time... Doto-chan
was right next to her, so why pick on me...? Machitan sad...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ah... Oh dear... I finally caught up to you~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, tag~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Aww, no way! And you're already fleeing?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan! Why have you been running right alongside me this
whole time?! You could have tagged me whenever you wanted, right?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I refuse to walk into your trap! The instant
I reach out, you intend to accelerate, do you not?!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Curtains fall on this little standoff!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: She saw right through me... And she still has plenty left in the tank...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: In that case, I'll break away right here!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: I shall not permit it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, nice dodge! You're pretty nimble on your feet, Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah... Phew, it's taking everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, your stamina is solid to keep running this long.
Plus... you've got surprisingly sharp spatial awareness.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Been doing some special cross-training? You've
gotta teach me about it... after this!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
And that concludes our joint session! Thank you
all very much for your spirited cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Same here, thanks for inviting us! It was super fun! Tomorrow I'll tackle practice with a fresh mindset!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: If you stick strictly to normal routines, your perspective gets narrow! Today was a fantastic learning opportunity!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...What's the matter, Kita-chan?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ...I realized our practice so far really meant something after all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ryan-san praised my running in tag today! I'm sure it's thanks to our team practice!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Mm, I feel the results too. Our seniors are so dependable.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right! It's so reassuring!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: —So! Based on what I noticed in joint practice, I designed a menu to target everyone's challenges!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! I see, maintaining stamina means targeting those specific muscle groups... This helps so much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Alright, let's kick off with our shared routine!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uwaah! This is tough~!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ah... thighs are burning... really feeling the burn~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You've got this, Bright! Steady at your own pace!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Wait... Bright-san's machine... is the resistance dial slowly increasing...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh? Come to think of it, her pedaling looked heavier than when we started...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I thought wearing weighted gear was just to get pumped up, but... this is intense...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Bright-san, please don't push past your limits!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Forgive my slow pace~... But this is merely the warm-up...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Starting tomorrow, we must lengthen our intervals... so hitting every daily milestone is essential...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: No problem, Bright can handle it! Alright, then I'm adding an extra set for myself!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Those two are incredible...! Tannhauser-san! Let's give it everything we've got too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Alright... still got energy left... Ten extra laps starting today—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Even so... this still isn't enough, is it...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan and Bright-san are pushing that hard. If I don't work even harder, I'll fall behind...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm... if only there were a way to boost efficiency, like Bright-san's weighted training gear...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Ah! That super energy tonic I saw on Umatter...! Drinking it before workouts beats standard protein shakes...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: —Time to brew one! Gotta try anything possible!
